exposure: leptin receptor (LEPR) expression level in maternal peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC)
leptin receptor (LEPR) expression level in placental tissue
cohort: The study included women with full-term gestation and their offspring.
finding: LEPR expression level in maternal PBMC correlates with newborn measurements independent from sex, and gestational weight gain can affect fetal development by increasing fetal birth weight.
